This script performs the  data preparation for ITS analysis. 

# Load everything
```{r}
results <- read_excel("sample_name_sequencing.xlsx",col_types = c("text","text", "text","text","text","text", "text"))

load("its_sequencing_result/seqtab.nochim.its.rdata")

load("its_sequencing_result/taxa.matrix.its.rdata")

```

# Data preparation
Add the sample IDs as in DADA2 to the sample dataframe
```{r}
samdf <- as.data.frame(results)
rownames(samdf) <- samdf$sample  # Define rownames

rownames(samdf) <- gsub(
  "^blanc\\.",
  "blanc-",
  rownames(samdf))
```

## Create a phyloseq object
```{r}
ps <- phyloseq(otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows=FALSE), sample_data(samdf), tax_table(taxa))

ntaxa(ps)  #Number of taxa 8920
nsamples(ps)  # Number of samples 341
```

#sequencing NTC
```{r}
# Select blank samples
ps_blancs <- prune_samples(grepl("^blanc", sample_names(ps)),ps)

sample_names(ps_blancs)

# Extract ASV abundance table
tab_blancs <- as(otu_table(ps_blancs), "matrix")

# Put samples in rows and ASVs in columns
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_blancs)) {
  tab_blancs <- t(tab_blancs)}

# Remove ASVs with zero abundance across all blanks
tab_blancs <- tab_blancs[,colSums(tab_blancs) > 0, drop = FALSE]

# Convert abundance table to a data frame
tableau_blancs <- as.data.frame(t(tab_blancs)) %>%
tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

# Extract taxonomy
tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps_blancs), "matrix")) %>%
tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

# Combine ASV abundances and taxonomy
tableau_blancs <- tableau_blancs %>%
dplyr::left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV") %>%
dplyr::select(-"Kingdom",-"Class", -"Order")
```

```{r}
library(decontam)

# Find blank
sample_data(ps)$is.neg <- grepl("^blanc-", sample_names(ps))

# Find contaminants
resultats_contam <- isContaminant(ps, method = "prevalence", neg = "is.neg")

sum(resultats_contam$contaminant, na.rm = TRUE) #152 ASV

# Extract contaminant
asv_conta <- rownames(resultats_contam)[ !is.na(resultats_contam$contaminant) & resultats_contam$contaminant]

tax_contam <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps), "matrix"))

tax_contam <- tax_contam[asv_conta, , drop = FALSE]

abund <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")

# in line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {abund <- t(abund)}

# Only blank
est_blanc <- grepl("^blanc-", rownames(abund))

# Abundance
abond_blancs <- colSums(abund[est_blanc, , drop = FALSE])
abond_sols <- colSums(abund[!est_blanc, , drop = FALSE])

# Recap table
comparaison <- data.frame(ASV = asv_conta, lectures_blancs = abond_blancs[asv_conta], lectures_sols = abond_sols[asv_conta])

# Soil abundance
abond_sols <- colSums(abund[!est_blanc, , drop = FALSE])

# ASV < 1000 reads
asv_faible_abondance <- names(abond_sols)[abond_sols < 1000]

length(asv_faible_abondance)

asv_a_retirer <- intersect(asv_conta,asv_faible_abondance)

ps_filtre <- prune_taxa(!taxa_names(ps) %in% asv_a_retirer,ps)
```

## Removing sequencing NTC
```{r}

ps <- subset_samples(ps_filtre, !sample %in% c("blanc.1", "blanc.2", "blanc.3", "blanc.4"))

ntaxa(ps)  # 8786
nsamples(ps)  # 337

```

##Rarefaction
```{r}
ps_micro <- prune_samples( grepl("^(ori|t0|t1|t2|tf)", sample_names(ps)), ps)

nsamples(ps_micro)  # Number of samples 300 ( /5 sampling time =60 ok)

# Abundance matrix
otu <- as(otu_table(ps_micro), "matrix")

# In line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_micro)) {
  otu <- t(otu)}

# Reads amount
profondeurs <- rowSums(otu)

# Statistic
summary(profondeurs)
#Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#84    4325    9224   12681   15572  129495 


# Rarefaction curves
rarecurve(otu, step = 1000, label = FALSE, xlab = "Nombre de lectures", ylab = "Richesse en ASV", col = "grey40", lwd = 1)

sum(sample_sums(ps_micro) < 1000)
#13
sum(sample_sums(ps_micro) < 5000)
#85
sum(sample_sums(ps_micro) < 10000)
#163

profondeur <- 1000

ps_filtre <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_micro) >= profondeur, ps_micro)

ps_filtre <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_filtre) > 0, ps_filtre)

nsamples(ps_filtre) #287
```

#rarefaction Amplicon tagger
```{r}
otu <- as(otu_table(ps_filtre), "matrix")

if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_filtre)) {otu <- t(otu)}

set.seed(123)
n_rarefactions <- 500

otu_somme <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(otu), ncol = ncol(otu), dimnames = dimnames(otu))

for (i in seq_len(n_rarefactions)) {otu_rarefie <- vegan::rrarefy(
t(otu), sample = profondeur)

otu_somme <- otu_somme + t(otu_rarefie)}

otu_moyenne <- otu_somme / n_rarefactions

otu_moyenne <- round(otu_moyenne)

ps_consensus <- phyloseq(otu_table(otu_moyenne, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
tax_table(ps_filtre), sample_data(ps_filtre))
```

# Creating number for each ASV
```{r}
asv_its_mapping <- data.frame(
ASV = taxa_names(ps_consensus),                                   # ASV
ASV_number = seq_len(ntaxa(ps_consensus)),                        # number
Taxa = apply(as(tax_table(ps_consensus), "matrix"), 1, paste, collapse = ";"))

save(asv_its_mapping, file = "its_sequencing_result/asv_its_mapping.RData")

save(ps_consensus, file = "its_sequencing_result/phyloseq_filtered_its.RData")
```
